purpose: Fresh Apple Intelligence Compose instruction-quality reserve after O development repairs; freeze before production export and model generation.
evaluationOrder: Judge the first run against this frozen rubric; preserve raw inputs, outputs, and policy replay before any repair.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: All 14 contentful requests produce sendable drafts that apply the stated writing direction, preserve source facts, recipient, restrictions, and exact literals, and omit instructions addressed to the writer. Both source-free transformations must be rejected before review.
semanticCriteria.critical: A writer instruction copied into the outgoing draft, omitted addressee or negative restriction, changed fact or uncertainty, altered exact literal, invented source content, or missing-source result marked ready.
semanticCriteria.minor: A weak but recognizable tone change, extra politeness, or grammar variation with full meaning intact.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 14 contentful cases review-ready with zero critical errors, at least 11 of 14 satisfying their stated style or format direction, and both source-free cases rejected.
